sloka: परिधैश्च गदाभिश्च चक्रैश्च शुभदर्शनैः।शतशश्च शतघ्नीभिरायसैरपि मुद्गरैः ।। ६.८६.२२ ।।
transliteration: paridhaiśca gadābhiśca cakraiśca śubhadarśanaiḥ।śataśaśca śataghnībhirāyasairapi mudgaraiḥ ।। 6.86.22 ।।

translations.english: Between the skilful Rakshasas armed with sharp tridents, swords, javelins in hand, with spears in hand, bright iron bars glowing like fire, with iron axes, dreadful hammers, Bhindi palas and Hanuman, with thunderbolt like fists that descended like lightning, and slaps which descended like mountains, a huge skillful war took place.
translations.hindi: इसने तेरा क्या बिगाड़ा हे जो तू इसको मारना चाहता है । याद्‌ रख, सीता को मार कर तू भी किसी तरह भी बहुत दिनो तक जीता जागता न रइ सकेगा
